summary: Turn demonstrated cross-repository AI failure patterns into test-only capability/regression fixtures and a deterministic render/grade harness without creating new requirements, building blocks or canonical truth stores.

requirements.rationale: The observed failure families are already substantially covered by existing requirements. The eval slice tests those requirements and does not promote new requirements.

issues_findings.rationale: Harvest, continuity, restart and prior audit findings now have reusable historical replay fixtures, but the harness does not claim the generic harvest runtime or full fresh-model execution is complete.

risks.rationale: The seven deduplicated failure families operationalize regression evidence for the existing risk model rather than adding a parallel risk taxonomy.

decisions_concepts.rationale: This slice deliberately places the failure corpus and eval contract under tests/evals so they do not become a new canonical concept/decision registry.

derived_views.rationale: No new canonical project-state source is introduced. Eval fixtures remain test evidence, so the generated canonical-source view does not need a new truth owner.

active_work.rationale: Known failures can now be rendered as model-independent eval prompts and deterministically graded after a run. Real fresh-model execution remains a separate empirical step.
